node.title: E22 dyadic-chain minimal-scale accounting
node.statement: For a finite dyadic chain of admissible scales, raw per-scale counts decompose triangularly by minimal scale: the raw count at scale M_j equals the selected minimal count at M_j plus the contributions from smaller minimal scales that are also admissible at M_j. Therefore exact selected counts are recovered by subtracting the smaller-scale overlap counts.
node.attack_surface: formal partition accounting on a finite totally ordered set
node.falsifier: a class counted at scale M_j whose minimal admissible scale is larger than M_j, or a class with no unique minimal scale
